audience: owner-operated HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and repair contractors
topic: estimate follow-up and field-to-office documentation for local contractors

products.name: Estimate Follow-Up Queue
products.product: A next-action pipeline for sent estimates that preserves job context, customer questions, decision dates, and closed reasons.
products.audience: owner-operated HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and repair contractors
products.problem: Estimates are sent from one system, then followed up from memory, causing inconsistent timing and little insight into why work is won or lost.
products.valueProposition: Creates a visible follow-up sequence that stops on a decision and records actionable loss reasons.
products.topic: contractor estimate follow-up and quote tracking
products.monetization: $19-$79/month based on active records or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets estimate follow-up text, contractor quote reminder, open estimate tracker, and field service sales pipeline searches.

products.name: Job Photo Handoff
products.product: A field-to-office workflow that organizes before, progress, completion, and exception photos by job and purpose.
products.audience: owner-operated HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and repair contractors
products.problem: Job photos remain on technicians' phones or in group chat without labels, making office review, invoicing, warranty response, and customer updates harder.
products.valueProposition: Prompts technicians for the required photo set, context, exceptions, and office acknowledgement before the job closes.
products.topic: contractor job photo documentation and field office handoff
products.monetization: $19-$79/month based on active records or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets jobsite photo checklist, contractor photo documentation app, before-and-after job photos, and technician closeout template searches.
